rationale: Build on the current reverse recurrent-tail best, but pivot away from repeated refine replays and failed generic output-head expansions. This patch removes the losing multi-stream shard path and adds a tiny tokenizer-aware conditional bias head keyed only by previous token class (special/boundary, byte, leading-space, continuation). The new head is byte-cheap, float-kept under the existing small-tensor rule, survives the final int8+zlib roundtrip well, and gives the proven bigram-plus-recurrent baseline a cleaner inductive bias for SentencePiece boundary transitions without disturbing the winning tail recurrence or wallclock behavior.
title: Prev-Token Class Bias On Reverse Tail Best
